parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Recycled waste plastic The table shows some information about the percentage of waste plastic that was recycled. Number of years after 1988 (x) 0 1 2 3 4 5 Percentage recycled (y) 2.0 2.7

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Each year after 1988 the percentage of waste plastic that was recycled increased by 0.7 . Complete the table. [2]

content.tex: Each year after 1988 the percentage of waste plastic that was recycled increased by 0.7 .

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) A straight line models the data in the table. Find the equation of the model for y in terms of x. ................................................. [2]

content.tex: A straight line models the data in the table.
Find the equation of the model for \(y\) in terms of x.

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Burned waste plastic The percentage of waste plastic that was burned also increased by 0.7 each year after 1988. In 1988 the percentage of waste plastic that was burned was 6.6 . y is now the percentage of waste plastic that was burned. x is still the number of years after 1988. Find the equation of the model for the percentage of waste plastic that was burned. ................................................. [1]

content.tex: The percentage of waste plastic that was burned also increased by 0.7 each year after 1988. In 1988 the percentage of waste plastic that was burned was 6.6 . \(y\) is now the percentage of waste plastic that was burned. \(x\) is still the number of years after 1988.
Find the equation of the model for the percentage of waste plastic that was burned.

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Describe fully the transformation that maps the graph of the model for recycled waste plastic onto the graph of the model for burned waste plastic. ..................................................................................................................................................... [2]

content.tex: Describe fully the transformation that maps the graph of the model for recycled waste plastic onto the graph of the model for burned waste plastic.

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Discarded waste plastic Waste plastic that is not recycled and is not burned is discarded. y is now the percentage of waste plastic that was discarded. x is still the number of years after 1988.

content.tex: Waste plastic that is not recycled and is not burned is discarded. \(y\) is now the percentage of waste plastic that was discarded. \(x\) is still the number of years after 1988.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Show that the model for discarded waste plastic is . . y x 1 4 92 8 = - + . [2]

content.tex: Show that the model for discarded waste plastic is \(y = -1.4x+92.8\) .
Explain why the model is not valid when \(x = 70\) .

parts.label: e
parts.text: (e) Find the number of years after 1988 when the percentage of discarded waste plastic is 49.4 . Use the model in part (d)(i). ................................................. [2]

content.tex: Find the number of years after 1988 when the percentage of discarded waste plastic is 49.4 . Use the model in part (d)(i).

parts.label: f
parts.text: (f) Find the year in which the percentage of recycled waste plastic becomes more than the percentage of discarded waste plastic. Use the models in part (a)(ii) and part (d)(i). ................................................. [5]
